cross_version_rationale: These sources use Python3.10 syntax. CPython3.13.5 independently accepts ordinary function annotation named expressions in both .py and .pyi and rejects a named expression in a postponed module annotation. Filename suffix does not introduce a Python annotation scope. Relative-future behavior is deliberately excluded because observed implementations disagree.
probe: compile_controls.py uses compile(..., dont_inherit=True). Evidence identity is checked; semantic interpretation remains reviewable.
